lines.text: These 3D cartoon reels? Claude made them.
No Blender. No animator. No AI video model.
And people sell courses on this.
I'll show you the steps for free. Claude, show them.
Step one. Write a tiny script. Just you and me, talking.
Step two. Turn it into two voices with ElevenLabs.
Then you make the video with AI?
Nope. Step three. I write code that builds the whole 3D world, block by block.
Step four. I sync every word, mouth and caption to the voice.
Step five. Your laptop renders it, frame by frame.
And I never touch the code?
Barely. You just tell me what to change.
Comment VOXEL and I'll send you the full guide with every prompt.
